# Grind District

> Grind District is a free 3D city game in the browser where complete beginners learn Web3 by living it: walk the city, finish short lessons with a guide named Zahra, work jobs, practise trading with in-game cash, and leave with a shareable CV and a certificate for every lesson passed, optionally minted on-chain as a soulbound NFT.

Key facts:

- Free to play at https://www.grinddistrict.app on a phone or computer. No download. No crypto wallet is needed to start or to earn certificates.
- Made for beginners and non-coders. 42 short lessons in 6 worlds: The Internet; The Scam That Taught Me (scam awareness and safe wallets); Blockchain Basics; Layers and Uses; The Earning Map (the real ways people earn in Web3); Your Career.
- The loop: walk the city, finish a short lesson, it is written onto your CV, claim a certificate.
- Every passed lesson is added to the player's public CV at https://www.grinddistrict.app/cv/<username>, with a certificate that has its own public link at https://www.grinddistrict.app/cert/<id>.
- On-chain proof is optional: after a short exam graded on the server, a certificate can be minted as a soulbound (non-transferable) NFT. Certificate NFTs are minted on NEAR during the beta, with Base support built in. The game reads them back from the chain and marks them Verified.
- Jobs and careers: paid kitchen shifts at McGrind (the city's burger restaurant) and 16 career tracks that open after World 5.
- Practice only: spot trading, perpetuals and DeFi use in-game cash earned by playing, never real money.
- Places include Campus, McGrind, Grind Café, the Trading floor, Grind Bank (how crypto institutions and spot crypto ETFs work, plus halal savings), a conference centre with Web3 events, a player-run market, homes, a gym, a masjid and a church.
- Plays in 13 languages: English, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, Hausa, Swahili, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, French, Portuguese, Hindi and Yoruba.
- Built by Zahra Usman.
